dct_title_s: Cook Islands - Tropical storm on Jan 11 2025
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[1001136\_4](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_ts_events/items?event_id=1001136) Tropical storm during the period Jan 11 2025-Jan 12 2025 in Cook Islands. The center of the storm was located near latitude -21.9 longitude -158.8. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
